source_document: Uniform CPA Examination Blueprints, approved by the Board of Examiners Aug. 18, 2025, effective January 2026 (CPA_Exam_Blueprints_2026.pdf)
note: Area, group and topic names transcribed verbatim from the AICPA's published AUD blueprint. This file is a structural reference for tagging questions; it contains no AICPA question content. Two modelling conventions: (1) blueprint Areas map to this engine's 'domains' and Groups to its 'sections'; (2) where the published blueprint defines no topic level under a group, the group name is carried as that section's single topic, so questions stay taggable without inventing subdivision the blueprint does not publish. Each area's 'weight' is the midpoint of the published range (midpoints sum to exactly 100), used for blueprint-weighted sampling; the official range is kept alongside it.

exam_format.format: multiple choice, four options, one correct
exam_format.note: This tool models the MCQ half of AUD only. The real section is 78 MCQs plus 7 task-based simulations in 240 minutes, scored 50% MCQ / 50% TBS. A mock here is the 78 MCQs at 120 minutes — the MCQ share of the official time — so pacing practice transfers; it is not the full exam and cannot be read as one.
